title_i18n.zh: 独家丨微软云亚太「一拆为二」，侯阳接掌东南亚、印度与大中华区
title_i18n.en: Exclusive | Microsoft Cloud Asia Pacific splits into two; Hou Yang takes charge of Southeast Asia, India, and Greater China
title_i18n.es: Exclusiva: Microsoft Cloud Asia-Pacífico se divide en dos; Hou Yang asume el Sudeste Asiático, India y Gran China.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 雷峰网独家获悉，今天早上，微软通过内部邮件宣布了一项组织调整：微软亚太区业务（主要是云业务）“一分为二”，日本、韩国、澳大利亚与新西兰市场由微软日本负责人津坂美树负责，大中华区、东盟与印度市场由微软大中华区原一把手侯阳负责。 这次变动，是此前微软亚太区总裁 Rodrigo Kede Lima 调任后引发的连锁调整。 今年 7 月初，微软成立了新的内部事业部 Microsoft Frontier Company，专注把“前线部署工程师”（FDE）这套模式推向市场，将 AI 嵌进客户的核心业务流中。Rodrigo Kede Lima 随即调任该部门，其原职位出现空缺，进而促成了此次“一拆二”的重组。 雷峰网雷峰网 关于此次人事调整背后的博弈故事，可添加作者微信  xf123a  交流。 ▼ 推荐阅读 ▼ AI人才3次大迁徙：百度先行、六小虎分化、腾讯「腾笼换鸟」 2026-08-25 独家丨从飞书火山整合，看阿里「云钉一体」踩过的坑 2026-08-05
excerpt_i18n.en: Leiphone has exclusively learned that this morning, Microsoft announced an organizational adjustment via internal email: its Asia-Pacific business (primarily cloud) has been "split in two." Japan, South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand will be led by Miki Tsusaka, head of Microsoft Japan, while Greater China, ASEAN, and India will be led by Hou Yang, former head of Microsoft Greater China. This change is a knock-on effect of the earlier transfer of Rodrigo Kede Lima, former President of Microsoft Asia-Pacific. In early July, Microsoft established a new internal division, Microsoft Frontier Company, focused on bringing the "Frontline Deployment Engineers" (FDE) model to market, embedding AI into clients' core business processes. Rodrigo Kede Lima was subsequently transferred to that division, leaving his former position vacant, which led to this restructuring into two parts. For more on the strategic maneuvering behind this personnel change, you can contact the author via WeChat: xf123a.

items.title: 原生全模态技术战略闭环，智象（HiDream.ai）发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied

title_i18n.zh: 原生全模态技术战略闭环，智象（HiDream.ai）发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied
title_i18n.en: Native full-modal technology strategic closed loop: ZhiXiang (HiDream.ai) releases embodied world model HiDream-O1-Embodied.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 今日，智象未来（HiDream.ai）正式发布具身世界模型HiDream-O1-Embodied。秉承原生全模态的技术理念，模型强化机器人物理感知与动态预判能力，助力具身智能实现更高阶的物理交互。具身模型的发布，标志着智象逐步实现了打通图像、视频、3D、动作等模态，贯通理解—推演—执行全流程，构建统一世界模型基座的技术闭环。
excerpt_i18n.en: Today, HiDream.ai officially released the embodied world model HiDream-O1-Embodied. Based on its native full-modality technology philosophy, the model enhances robots' physical perception and dynamic prediction capabilities, enabling higher-level physical interaction for embodied intelligence. The release of the embodied model marks HiDream's progressive achievement of a technical closed loop that integrates image, video, 3D, and action modalities, spans the full pipeline of understanding–reasoning–execution, and builds a unified world model foundation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, HiDream.ai ha lanzado oficialmente su modelo de mundo incorporado HiDream-O1-Embodied. Siguiendo el enfoque tecnológico de multimodalidad nativa, el modelo refuerza la percepción física y la predicción dinámica de los robots, impulsando la inteligencia incorporada hacia interacciones físicas de mayor nivel. Con el lanzamiento de este modelo incorporado, HiDream avanza en la integración de modalidades como imagen, vídeo, 3D y acción, completando el ciclo de comprensión-inferencia-ejecución y consolidando su infraestructura tecnológica para un modelo de mundo unificado.

items.title: Open-source AI policies and "responsbility"
items.raw_excerpt: A common statement in a number of LLM/AI policies regarding AI assisted contributions across open source projects is that the developer is "responsible" for their contribution even if it was made wholly or in part by AI. I understand in layman's terms what this means and I can guess at the intent (essentially you can't blame claude for the code crashing) but responsibility as a word usually implies consequences. In the pre-AI times, were developers who submitted code that lead to crashes or bugs sanctioned in anyway? Perhaps if it were proven to be malicious (e.g. the Jia Tan incident), but usually bugs are unintentional no? What does "responsbility" even entail in open source projects and contributions?

title_i18n.en: Open-source AI policies and "responsbility"
title_i18n.zh: 开源AI政策与责任

excerpt_i18n.en: A common statement in a number of LLM/AI policies regarding AI assisted contributions across open source projects is that the developer is "responsible" for their contribution even if it was made wholly or in part by AI. I understand in layman's terms what this means and I can guess at the intent (essentially you can't blame claude for the code crashing) but responsibility as a word usually implies consequences. In the pre-AI times, were developers who submitted code that lead to crashes or bugs sanctioned in anyway? Perhaps if it were proven to be malicious (e.g. the Jia Tan incident), but usually bugs are unintentional no? What does "responsbility" even entail in open source projects and contributions?
excerpt_i18n.zh: 许多LLM/AI政策中关于开源项目中AI辅助贡献的常见声明是，开发者对其贡献负有责任，即使该贡献完全或部分由AI完成。

items.title: 俞敏洪：我这几年特别不安分，弄得名声比较大；传DeepSeek将采购16万颗华为AI芯片；特斯拉无人驾驶出租车，将24小时全天候运营丨雷峰早报
items.raw_excerpt: 要闻提示 1.特斯拉无人驾驶出租车，将24小时全天候运营 2.“打价格战没前途”！俞敏洪：我这几年特别不安分，弄得名声比较大 3.传DeepSeek将采购16万颗华为AI芯片 4.何庭波公开麒麟2026实测：密度暴涨55%，NPU功耗反降66% 5.雷军谈“增程汽车大有可为”：同行已不断证明，用户愿意为优秀增程车买单 6.阿里千问开源 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B：首个面向自动驾驶的视觉语言基础模型 7.黑芝麻智能杨宇欣离职，小鹏“新兵”接棒 8.GPT-6 Astra登顶Code Arena，OpenAI被曝多次改动基准数据 今日头条 特斯拉无人驾驶出租车，将24小时全天候运营 9月6日消息，据外媒报道，特斯拉 AI 负责人阿肖克・埃卢斯瓦米日前表示，Robotaxi 全天候 24 小时服务即将落地。有网友在 X 平台留言，希望 Cybercab 可以提供夜间出行服务，他回复称，待 “v15 方案中下一阶段技术完成整合” 后，该功能大概下个月上线。 这条评论发布于 9 月 4 日，就在特斯拉在奥斯汀开放 Cybercab 公众试乘的次日。这也是目前特斯拉给出的、关于无人车全天候运营最明确的短期时间表。目前，特斯拉付费 Robotaxi 网络在奥斯汀、达拉斯、休斯顿、迈阿密、奥兰多、坦帕六地每周 7 天运营，服务时段为早 6 点至晚 10 点。 埃卢斯瓦米并未透露具体功能，也没有说明该升级会优先落地专属车型 Cybercab、现有 Model Y 车队，还是两者同步上线，同时没有公布分城市推广清单。如果下一模块按照埃卢斯瓦米给出的时间表落地，2026 年 10 月，至少部分市场有望开通 24 小时 Robotaxi 服务。（三言科技） 国内资讯 “打价格战没前途”！俞敏洪：我这几年特别不安分，弄得名声比较大 9月6日消息，日前，在2026年亚布力论坛夏季年会开幕式上，
